other_buildings._note: No rent roll yet for B04-B13 (they are context buildings, not AMF's own). context_occupancy below gives each of them a made-up but plausible per-floor vacant share instead of a single site-wide guess: offices around Stockholm's current going vacancy rate (4-18%, ground floor more volatile) with per-floor noise; residential near-fully-let (0-3%, Swedish rental housing runs close to zero vacancy) with at most one floor showing a between-tenants gap. Generated once by a seeded script (not re-run at request time) so it is stable to look at; replace a building's row with real figures as they arrive, same shape (one share per floor, 0 = fully let, 1 = fully vacant). B02 and B03 are deliberately missing here now: AMF's real schedule (data/projects/marievik/phasing.json) covers them instead (M19 and M26) — not yet wired into this fallback since its exact dates are unconfirmed; floor_tenancy() currently falls back to the old hashed guess for B02/B03 until that is resolved.
